description: Edit an existing time entry — notes, start/end, break, billable flag, work role or work type. Only provided fields change. Duration is set by time_start/time_end (hours are derived, not edited directly); use hours_deduct for a break inside that span. Governed by your ConnectWise security role (typically your own entries).

hours_deduct.description: Break to subtract, in hours (CW's Deduct). Keep time_start/time_end the real span and put the break here — actual hours become span minus deduct

response_format.description: Output format: human-readable markdown (default) or structured JSON

time_end.description: New end time, ISO 8601 (changes the billed hours)

work_role.description: Work role name — decides the rate (see cw_list_work_roles)

name: cw_update_time_entry
title: Update ConnectWise Time Entry
